exposure: Somatic mutations in genes of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway
outcome: Abundant proliferation of tissues or organs
cohort: Six patients with diverse clinical forms of overgrowth and pathogenic variants in genes of the mTOR pathway.
finding: Somatic mutations in genes of the mTOR pathway are responsible for segmental overgrowth syndromes, which show a wide spectrum of severity, leading to a reconsideration of their clinical spectrum and surveillance programs.
